_comment: Original, IP-free assets. All characters are generic archetypes described purely by appearance; no real people, shows, teams, or trademarks are referenced. Gear is explicitly PLAIN and UNBRANDED, and the global negative_prompt bans logos/brands/text so Meshy does not hallucinate real team crests or sponsor marks. Home = teal/white, Away = red/black. priority 1 = essential, 2 = roster depth, 3 = nice-to-have.

defaults.negative_prompt: logo, logos, text, lettering, numbers, words, brand, brand name, sponsor, trademark, emblem, team crest, nike, adidas, reebok, NHL, NHL team, swoosh, watermark, signature, label, decal, graphic print
